base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019" FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1."XCL_022" = T2."XCL_005"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T3 ON T1."XCL_018" = T3."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T4 ON T3."XCL_010" = T4."XCL_003"
WHERE T2."XCL_006" = 'Blue' AND T4."XCL_004" = 'Speed' AND T3."XCL_011" = 100
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hero_power AS T5 WHERE T5."XCL_012" = T1."XCL_018")
